name: Grid Job Result
description: grid_job_result: Compatibility entry point for waiting for an existing Job's output. Prefer job_result when available. A failed, rejected or cancelled target fails the wait. Legacy behavior: omitted or non-positive timeout waits indefinitely; an unbounded remote waiter mirrors the target's input/auth-required state. Send input to the target, not this waiter. A timeout does not cancel remote work; do not resubmit it. For local Jobs, requires job/read on the target Job. Remote access is authorized by the hosting venue using the selected remote identity and grants.

id.description: Exact Job ID on the selected hosting venue. A local wrapper and its destination are separate Jobs: use the ID of the one you intend to inspect or control. Agent, session and tool-call IDs are not Job IDs.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait. Legacy behavior: omitted or <=0 means no deadline. Expiry fails this wait, not the target execution.

venue.description: Hosting venue HTTP(S) URL or routable DID. Omit for a local Job, including a local proxy. For a destination Job use its own ID and hosting venue. A definition may set a default venue; this input overrides it. Null is invalid.

authenticateAs.description: Remote identity: anonymous (default) sends no identity or grants; caller requires your identity credential addressed to the target venue, with no capabilities, plus any separate grants; venue is only for the venue itself. Use the same mode and credentials when following the Job. Local calls retain your caller context.

owner.description: Job owner DID for delegated lookup, including retained Jobs. This grants no authority.

output.description: Output value of the referenced job
